first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding improves both time-to-value and early adoption. Verify the archived record before running a standard experiment, while monitoring qualified pipeline and retention so higher completion does not mask lower-value accounts.

final.rationale: Run a standard A/B experiment shortening onboarding this week. The verified source shows completion improving 13%, time-to-value falling 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rising 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Track qualified activation, conversion, retention, and downstream revenue—not completion alone—to detect any quality tradeoff.
